success_patterns: Carry an explicitly established trip destination forward into location fields for later requested domains, such as a flight destination or attraction search, instead of asking the user to repeat it.

patch.reasoning: Both trajectories rely on destination context established elsewhere in the conversation. Making this carry-forward behavior explicit helps avoid redundant clarification while preserving the rule not to guess an unstated or ambiguous endpoint.

edits.target: Still perform every independent requested search or update whose own required inputs are complete in the same turn.
edits.content: - When the conversation explicitly establishes a single trip destination, carry its city forward to location fields for later requested domains (for example, as a flight destination or attraction-search city); do not ask for it again merely because it was not repeated in the latest turn. Do not infer a destination when none is stated or the context is ambiguous.
